CONFIG CONTRACT — IMPORTANT. The spec documents ONLY visual_scaffold.type (renderer router) and visual_scaffold.description (layout context); it defines no per-type config keys anywhere. No `config` key exists in any of the 819 enriched records. The de-facto bank contract is exactly four keys on every scaffold: type, description, elements[] (typed element objects with a rigidly consistent per-type vocabulary — verified identical signatures across all books), textual_equivalent (accessibility fallback, 819/819 present). New enrichment should emit all four; the elements[] vocabulary per type is captured in each rubric entry's config_keys. Renderer selection: type is the primary router; unknown or missing type falls back technique-mapping → content_type → TextScaffold (never crashes).

FLAG-DIGIT DIVISION (Dhvajanka / straight division) candidates. The step shape is digit-serial columnar: split divisor into main part + flag digit; each step produces one quotient digit, then subtracts flag×(previous quotient digit) from the next dividend column to form the working remainder. Primary: place_value_chart — the columnar write-digit/adjust-next-column flow with carry/borrow arrows matches exactly, and the bank's digit-serial division walkthroughs (Ekadhikena recurring-decimal expansion, Basic Operations division) already sit on it. Secondary: arrow_matrix — the flag correction is structurally a crosswise product (inverse-Urdhva), and Paravartya Yojayet division-family templates are observed on arrow_matrix (×10). Either is defensible; place_value_chart when the walkthrough is written column-by-column with remainders, arrow_matrix when it emphasizes the cross-product corrections.

DEFICIENCY SQUARING (Yavadunam) candidates. Step shape: deficiency d = base − n; left part = n − d; right part = d² padded to base width, with possible carry from d² overflowing into the left part. Primary: arrow_matrix — Yavadunam is the a=b special case of Nikhilam base-complement multiplication, and the Nikhilam family is predominantly arrow_matrix in the bank (×71 vs ×31 place_value_chart). Secondary: place_value_chart — equally defensible when the walkthrough is written as left-slot/right-slot place-value assembly with a carry.

SAFE FALLBACK. textual_scaffold. It routes to TextScaffold, which the spec insists is NOT a degraded fallback but the full SolveAlongStepper (all 5 layers, all 3 modes, traps, hints, remediation). Prefer emitting textual_scaffold over omitting visual_scaffold entirely: the §9 deployment check wants visual_scaffold.type set ('preferred'), and the explicit type also carries the text_badge/highlight/annotation elements. Never fall back to equation_chain or shape_canvas — both renderers are TBD with zero observed usage.
